_doc: KEYWORD catalog for no-code test cases — the akaAT Studio WEB keyword set (docs 5.1 Web Keywords; Core/Control/API/Random come later) plus a few extra helpers. ONE single source: the runner (shared/keyword/engine.ts) looks up how to execute by `id`, the console builds the input fields from `args`. To add a keyword, add a block here THEN write a handler with the same `id` in engine.ts — if the handler is missing, the runner reports it as soon as the test case is loaded.
_doc_args: Each argument: name (key in call.args), label (text shown on the console), type (text|number|select|multiline), required, placeholder, options (for select). `object: true` means the keyword needs a test object; `object: 'optional'` means it may take one; `returns: true` means the keyword produces a value: the console shows an Output variable field and the value is stored in ${var:<output>}.
_doc_placeholder: Argument values may embed: ${data:key} taken from the suite's Test data, ${var:name} taken from a variable produced by a keyword (Output variable), ${global:name} taken from the project's Global variables, ${env:NAME} taken from the environment's .env file.
_doc_object_types: Test object names must start with the prefix of their element type (btn_dat_mua, input_sdt, label_tieu_de). The console dialog adds it, the recorder infers it from the element, and the server rejects names without a known prefix.

keywords.label: Open Browser
keywords.summary: Open a page at the given URL (a full URL, or a path of the app already open).

keywords.label: Navigate To URL
keywords.summary: Go from the current page to the given URL/path, keeping the current session.

keywords.label: Refresh
keywords.summary: Reload the current page — used to check whether the session survives a reload.

keywords.label: Back
keywords.summary: The browser's Back button.

keywords.label: Forward
keywords.summary: The browser's Forward button.

keywords.label: Delete All Cookies
keywords.summary: Delete every cookie of the browser session.

keywords.label: Clear Browser Session
keywords.summary: Log out by wiping the session: cookies plus localStorage and sessionStorage of the open page, then open the URL (or reload).
keywords.detail: Use it to switch role inside one test case: Clear Browser Session → log in as the next user. Storage is cleared for the site that is open at that moment.

keywords.label: Open New Tab
keywords.summary: Open a new tab at the URL and make it the current window.

keywords.label: Close Current Window
keywords.summary: Close the current tab and switch back to the first remaining one.

keywords.label: Get Current Window Title
keywords.summary: Store the current page title into the output variable.

keywords.label: Get Current Window URL
keywords.summary: Store the current page URL into the output variable.

keywords.label: Get Window Count
keywords.summary: Store the number of open tabs into the output variable.

keywords.label: Switch To Window By Title
keywords.summary: Make the tab whose title contains the text the current window.

keywords.label: Switch To Window By URL
keywords.summary: Make the tab whose URL contains the text the current window.

keywords.label: Click
keywords.summary: Click the test object.
keywords.detail: Waits for the test object to be visible and clickable before clicking, so no extra wait step is needed beforehand.

keywords.label: Double Click
keywords.summary: Double-click the test object.

keywords.label: Right Click
keywords.summary: Right-click the test object.

keywords.label: Click With Javascript
keywords.summary: Click the test object through JavaScript (bypasses overlays that intercept the pointer).

keywords.label: Click And Download
keywords.summary: Click the test object, wait for the browser download to finish, and store the downloaded file name.
keywords.detail: Fails when no download starts or the file is empty. Check the name afterwards with Verify Variable (equals / contains).

keywords.label: Mouse Over
keywords.summary: Hover the mouse over the test object.

keywords.label: Send Keys
keywords.summary: Type the keys into the test object. On an input or textarea the current value is replaced; elsewhere the keys are pressed one by one.

keywords.label: Send Special Keyboard Character
keywords.summary: Press a special key (Enter, Escape, Tab, ArrowDown…) on the test object, or on the page when no object is selected.

keywords.label: Drag And Drop By Offset
keywords.summary: Drag the test object and drop it at an offset (pixels).

keywords.label: Drag And Drop To Element
keywords.summary: Drag the test object and drop it onto another test object.

keywords.label: Scroll To Element
keywords.summary: Scroll until the test object is within the viewport.

keywords.label: Click If Present
keywords.summary: Click when the test object is present; if it is not, skip without reporting an error.
keywords.detail: For things that come and go — a rating prompt, a promo banner. Do not use it instead of "Click" for a mandatory step.

keywords.label: Scroll To Bottom
keywords.summary: Scroll to the end of the content area — used to trigger lazy-loading.

keywords.label: Clear Text
keywords.summary: Leave the input empty — usually used to check whether a button becomes disabled again.

keywords.label: Upload File
keywords.summary: Attach files to a file input or an upload area.
keywords.detail: The test object can be the <input type="file"> (hidden is fine), an element that contains one, or a button/drop zone that opens the file picker. Relative paths are read from e2e/testdata/files/; separate several files with ";".

keywords.label: Submit
keywords.summary: Submit the form that contains the test object.

keywords.label: Set Attribute
keywords.summary: Set an attribute on the test object.

keywords.label: Set CSS Attribute
keywords.summary: Set a CSS property on the test object.

keywords.label: Get Text
keywords.summary: Store the test object's visible text into the output variable.
keywords.detail: Used to bridge two screens: take the order code on the list screen, then verify the same code on the detail screen.

keywords.label: Get Text From Multiple Elements
keywords.summary: Store the texts of every element matching the test object into the output variable (JSON array).

keywords.label: Get Attribute Value
keywords.summary: Store the test object's attribute value into the output variable.

keywords.label: Get CSS Attribute Value
keywords.summary: Store the test object's computed CSS property into the output variable.

keywords.label: Select Option By Index
keywords.summary: Select the option at the position (starts at 0) of a <select>.

keywords.label: Select Option By Label
keywords.summary: Select the option of a <select> by its visible text.

keywords.label: Select Option By Value
keywords.summary: Select the option of a <select> by its value attribute.

keywords.label: Select All Options
keywords.summary: Select every option of a multiple <select>.

keywords.label: Deselect Option By Index
keywords.summary: Deselect the option at the position of a multiple <select>.

keywords.label: Deselect Option By Label
keywords.summary: Deselect the option by its visible text.

keywords.label: Deselect Option By Value
keywords.summary: Deselect the option by its value attribute.

keywords.label: Deselect All Options
keywords.summary: Deselect every option of a multiple <select>.

keywords.label: Get Number Of Option
keywords.summary: Store the number of options of the <select> into the output variable.

keywords.label: Get Number Of Selected Option
keywords.summary: Store the number of selected options into the output variable.

keywords.label: Select Item By Text
keywords.summary: Click the item of an open sheet/list whose visible text contains the value.
keywords.detail: For the app's custom lists (province, ward, product…) that are not <select> elements. Matching ignores case and NFC/NFD differences.

keywords.label: Accept Alert
keywords.summary: Click OK on the open alert/confirm/prompt.

keywords.label: Dismiss Alert
keywords.summary: Click Cancel on the open alert/confirm/prompt.

keywords.label: Get Alert Text
keywords.summary: Store the text of the open alert into the output variable.

keywords.label: Set Text On Alert
keywords.summary: Type the text into the open prompt and accept it.

keywords.label: Wait For Alert
keywords.summary: Wait until an alert is open.

keywords.label: Verify Alert Present
keywords.summary: An alert must be open (within the timeout).

keywords.label: Verify Alert Not Present
keywords.summary: No alert may be open.

keywords.label: Switch To Frame
keywords.summary: Make the iframe pointed to by the test object the current context — following keywords look inside it.

keywords.label: Switch To Frame By Name Or ID
keywords.summary: Make the iframe with this name/id the current context.

keywords.label: Switch To Default Content
keywords.summary: Leave the iframe and go back to the main page.

keywords.label: Verify Element Present
keywords.summary: The test object must exist in the DOM (visible or not).

keywords.label: Verify Element Not Present
keywords.summary: The test object must not exist in the DOM.

keywords.label: Verify Element Visible
keywords.summary: The test object must be visible on screen.

keywords.label: Verify Element Not Visible
keywords.summary: The test object must not be visible (it may still exist in the DOM).

keywords.label: Verify Element Enable
keywords.summary: The button/input must be enabled.

keywords.label: Verify Element Disable
keywords.summary: The button/input must be disabled.

keywords.label: Verify Element Clickable
keywords.summary: The test object must be visible and enabled.

keywords.label: Verify Element Has Attribute
keywords.summary: The test object must have the attribute.

keywords.label: Verify Element Not Has Attribute
keywords.summary: The test object must not have the attribute.

keywords.label: Verify Element Attribute Value
keywords.summary: The attribute of the test object must equal the expected value.

keywords.label: Verify Element Attribute Value By Regex
keywords.summary: The attribute of the test object must match the regex.

keywords.label: Verify Element Attribute Value Different
keywords.summary: The attribute of the test object must differ from the value.

keywords.label: Verify Element Text
keywords.summary: The test object's text must equal the expected text.
keywords.detail: Both sides are NFC-normalized before matching.

keywords.label: Verify Element Text By Regex
keywords.summary: The test object's text must match the regex.

keywords.label: Verify Element Text Different From
keywords.summary: The test object's text must differ from the value.

keywords.label: Verify Text Present
keywords.summary: The text must appear — inside the test object if one is selected, otherwise anywhere on the page.
keywords.detail: Both sides are NFC-normalized before matching, so hand-typed Vietnamese text does not fail unfairly.

keywords.label: Verify Text Not Present
keywords.summary: The text must not appear on the page.

keywords.label: Verify Input Value
keywords.summary: The input must currently hold exactly this value.

keywords.label: Verify Input Empty
keywords.summary: The input must currently be empty.

keywords.label: Verify Element Count
keywords.summary: The number of elements matching the test object must equal exactly this number.

keywords.label: Verify URL Contains
keywords.summary: The current URL must contain this fragment.

keywords.label: Verify Option Present By Label
keywords.summary: The <select> must contain an option with this visible text.

keywords.label: Verify Option Present By Value
keywords.summary: The <select> must contain an option with this value.

keywords.label: Verify Option Selected By Index
keywords.summary: The option at the position must be selected.

keywords.label: Verify Option Selected By Label
keywords.summary: The option with this visible text must be selected.

keywords.label: Verify Option Selected By Value
keywords.summary: The option with this value must be selected.

keywords.label: Verify Option Deselected By Index
keywords.summary: The option at the position must not be selected.

keywords.label: Verify Option Deselected By Label
keywords.summary: The option with this visible text must not be selected.

keywords.label: Verify Option Deselected By Value
keywords.summary: The option with this value must not be selected.

keywords.label: Wait For Element Present
keywords.summary: Wait until the test object exists in the DOM.

keywords.label: Wait For Element Not Present
keywords.summary: Wait until the test object no longer exists in the DOM.

keywords.label: Wait For Element Visible
keywords.summary: Wait until the test object is visible.
keywords.detail: In most cases NOT needed: the interaction keywords already wait on their own.

keywords.label: Wait For Element Not Visible
keywords.summary: Wait until the test object is hidden — e.g. a loading screen disappearing.

keywords.label: Wait For Element Enabled
keywords.summary: Wait until the test object is enabled.

keywords.label: Wait For Element Disabled
keywords.summary: Wait until the test object is disabled.

keywords.label: Wait For Element Clickable
keywords.summary: Wait until the test object is visible and enabled.

keywords.label: Wait For Text
keywords.summary: Wait until the text appears on the page.

keywords.label: Execute Javascript
keywords.summary: Run JavaScript in the page; the returned value goes to the output variable.

keywords.label: Wait
keywords.summary: Pause for a fixed number of milliseconds.
keywords.detail: Use sparingly: hard waits make test cases both slow and flaky. Prefer "Wait For Element Visible".

keywords.label: Set Variable Value
keywords.summary: Assign a value to a variable so later steps can reuse it via ${var:name}.

keywords.label: Generate Unique Code
keywords.summary: Produce a code unique to this run (prefix-yyMMdd-HHmmss-xxx) — tag the data a test case creates so Tear down can find and clean exactly that data.

keywords.label: Get Date
keywords.summary: Store today plus/minus N days (Vietnam time) in the given format — e.g. a deadline of today + 10 or a date already past.

keywords.label: Verify Variable
keywords.summary: Compare a captured variable with an expected value.

keywords.label: Take Screenshot
keywords.summary: Attach a screenshot to this step's report.

keywords.label: Comment
keywords.summary: Does nothing — only splits the test case into blocks for the reader.
